name: ai-contextview
description: A front end for Claude's questions: each question shows next to the document passage and the code it is about. Ask mode (the ask-mode skill) sends every question of a session there; the spec-elaborate skill writes a spec with you on top of it. In a browser page, or in a pane beside the chat (the -mod skills). Needs the ai-contextview binary for the browser page; see https://github.com/rrgmc/ai-contextview#install
